cited.quote: cultivation of highly nutritive millets, pulses, oilseeds and cotton by distributing seeds and inputs with subsidy

rationale: C1 describes the Dry land Development Mission giving seeds and inputs with subsidy and watershed works; C2 covers farm ponds and machinery. None of the extracts shows cash incentives to dry land farmers for producing millets. Related activity only.

cited.quote: were unveiled by the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu on 14.02.2023

rationale: C1 reports full size statues of Veera Pandiya Kattabomman and the Maruthu Brothers at Gandhi Mandapam, Guindy, Chennai, unveiled by the Chief Minister on 14.02.2023. This matches the promise. The other extracts are unrelated.

cited.quote: issue orders for enhancing the compensation from Rs.4.00 lakhs (Rupees four lakhs) to Rs.5.00 takhs
the relief amount for death and permanent disability has been increased from Rs.4 lakh to Rs.5 lakh

rationale: C2 is the GO dated 03.11.2021 raising compensation for loss of human life to Rs.5 lakh, the promised amount (the existing base was Rs.4 lakh). C3 confirms it is paid from 03.11.2021. C1 later raised it to Rs.10 lakh.

None of the extracts mentions a seabridge between Chennai Port and Thiruvottriyur or any request to the Union about it. C2 and C3 urge the Union on Metro Rail, and C1, C4 and C5 cover ports policy and road works.

cited.quote: Hence an early decision on this issue considering all dimensions and including the observations
those appointed on or after 01-04-2003 are covered under Contributory Pension Scheme

rationale: C3 says only that a decision will be taken soon on the expert committee's report. C2 (2024-25) shows employees appointed after 01-04-2003 are still under the Contributory Pension Scheme. No official step restores the old pension scheme.

cited.quote: The Department of Textiles has been created in the year 2021 by bifurcating the erstwhile Department of Handlooms and Textiles

rationale: C1 reports that a separate Department of Textiles was created in 2021 to focus on developing the textile sector. It is a department, not explicitly a 'commission', so whether it matches the promise is doubtful. C4 and C5 (the textile policy GO) add no commission.
C1 to C3 describe TNRDC's projects and functions, and C4 and C5 are unrelated service rules. No extract mentions appointing road workers, a recruitment of 75,000, or reserving posts for women.

cited.quote: Every year awareness programmes are conducted to create awareness for Medicinal Plants Cultivation in Tamil Nadu

rationale: Directional. C1 shows only recurring awareness programmes by the Medicinal Plants Board, and C2 and C3 cover TAMPCOL's ongoing manufacture of medicines. No new GO, scheme or programme for growing Siddha herbs or ensuring them a fair price.

The promise does not say what the 'matters' are. C1 (commercial tax investigation units), C2 (DVAC), C4 (special task force on crimes against women) and C3 and C5 (unrelated) cannot be tied to the commitment, and none shows a new investigation section created for it.

No extract mentions renovating the Kannika sluice gate. C1 and C4 cover Kuthiraiyar and Adavinainarkoil dam sluices, C2 the Poondi sluices, C3 a Vellore dam, and C5 the Kanniseri check dam and canals in Virudhunagar. Those are different structures.

No extract concerns periodic (time-scale) pay for a group of 20,000 teachers. C1 is a CAG note on guest lecturers, C2 covers teacher training, C3 lists staff posts, C4 covers contract staff pay in a water project, and C5 the TRB restructuring.

cited.quote: powerlooms are charged uniform increased rate of 70 paise per unit as energy charges

rationale: C1, C2 and C5 show powerloom free units raised to 1000 and a uniform 70 paise rate above them. No extract moves units of 20 to 40 hp from tariff III B to the subsidised tariff III A 1.

None of the extracts mentions recovering inscriptions from the Archaeological Survey's office in Mysore. C1 to C3 cover state epigraphy, preservation of sculptures and site museums, and C4 and C5 the restoration of buildings.

cited.quote: Indian Oil Corporation Limited (M/s. IOCL) are laying Re-gasified Liquefied Natural Gas (R-LNG) pipelines from Ennore to Tuticorin
it is proposed to avail R-LNG from IOCL to make up the shortfall of natural

rationale: C4 says IOCL (not the state) is laying an Ennore to Tuticorin pipeline and TANGEDCO is only considering using it. C1 shows only a proposal and talks with IOCL. No state step lays pipelines from Ennore LNG to power stations for 2000 MW.

cited.quote: prevent illegal discharge of sewage, protection of water bodies in Local Bodies
Chennai Metropolitan Area Septage Management (Regulation) Rules, 2022 have been issued vide the Government Order
Trash Boom to Mitigate Plastic Pollution in Rivers in Tamil Nadu - Pilot project in Chennai riverline

rationale: C1 and C2 are the GO of 2023-01-02 with regulations, covering the Chennai Metropolitan Area, to prevent illegal sewage discharge into water bodies. C5 is a 2025 GO to remove waste from Chennai's rivers (a trash boom pilot). The order is not river-specific, hence the moderate confidence.

cited.quote: GCC has procured 6 Nos. of hybrid Drones to spray larvicide in waterways

rationale: C2 and C3 describe the Chennai Corporation's routine vector control (larvicide in drains and canals, fogging, drones), and C1 general dengue control. None of it is a dated new measure launched for the waterways initiative, and nothing addresses malodour.

cited.quote: TNMSC procures and supplies Beltless Sanitary Napkins under the Menstural Hygiene programme to

rationale: C1 and C3 show sanitary napkins distributed under the Menstrual Hygiene Programme. C2 is an older audit about past vending machines and C4 covers school toilet cleaning. No step installs free napkin vending machines in government and aided schools and colleges.

cited.quote: From May 2021 to May 2024, 15,79,393 new family cards have been issued to the eligible applicants

rationale: C1 to C3 report the number of new smart family cards issued, but none sets or reports a 15-day limit for issuing a card after application. Issuing cards is ongoing routine activity, with no official step for the time-bound commitment.

cited.quote: 8.45 crore units of surplus electricity generated has been exported to the grid of TANGEDCO

rationale: Directional. C1, C2 and C5 show existing co-generation plants in cooperative sugar mills exporting surplus power to TANGEDCO's grid, which was already happening in 2020-21. No new action plan or dedicated measure for TANGEDCO to buy power directly from sugar factories.
